profile.name: Muhammad Hafidz
profile.title: Creative & Corporate Communications
profile.hook: I help brands turn complex messages into something people can easily understand and remember.

about.heading: Corporate Communication & Public Engagement
about.body: Skilled in crafting and delivering clear, audience-driven messages that strengthen brand trust and engagement. Adept at developing communication materials that connect with diverse stakeholders across internal and external platforms.

about.heading: Stakeholder & Relationship Management
about.body: Experienced in fostering strong professional relationships through collaborative communication and event engagement. Able to align objectives between internal teams, partners, and the public to ensure cohesive brand representation.

about.heading: Event & Activation Management
about.body: Led on-ground engagement at events including the HRM DCO Townhall 2022 and Health Cancer Day, managing the EPF i-Lindung booth to promote Etiqa's Critical Care Takaful Plus product and strengthen product awareness through direct public engagement.

about.heading: Creative Communication & Design Thinking
about.body: Versatile in multimedia production and visual storytelling. Skilled in transforming complex product information into engaging, relatable content that resonates with both internal audiences and the general public.
